description: A Fabric mod that lets you play any of the official Minecraft music tracks on demand. Requires Fabric API

mods.name: Music Controller
mods.description: Control Minecraft music on demand. Open the in-game UI with M, browse all 63 built-in songs, search by name, and control playback with keyboard shortcuts. Suppresses vanilla background music while active and shows a Now Playing toast.

releases.notes:
**Music Controller v1.0.0**

---

   What's New
- Initial release

### Features
- Browse and play all 63 official Minecraft music tracks from an in-game UI
- Search tracks by name
- Full playback controls — previous, play, pause, next, stop
- Keyboard shortcuts (`M` open, `[` prev, `P` pause, `]` next, `K` stop)
- Vanilla "Now Playing" toast shows the current track name
- Vanilla background music suppressed while mod is active
- Automatically stops when a music disc is played in the world
- Vanilla music resumes instantly after stopping

### Requirements
- Minecraft 26.1.2
- Fabric Loader ≥ 0.17.3
- Fabric API

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/SwayGamer/Music-Controller/commits/V1.0.0
